bugs.title: POST /api/retail/returns ignores original invoice and allows arbitrary refunds
bugs.spec: readme.md §8.5; return must validate against sold_qty - already_returned_qty
bugs.expected: 400 when returning non-existent invoice, non-purchased item, or quantity > sold
bugs.actual: original_sale_id is destructured but never queried; returns minted arbitrarily

bugs.title: POS sale attaches to another branch's open shift
bugs.spec: Golden Rule 1; one shift per branch
bugs.expected: sale attaches only to caller branch open shift
bugs.actual: shift query is global, attaches to foreign open shift if none in caller branch

bugs.title: GET /api/retail/sales/:id and /shifts/:id/report lack branch scope checks
bugs.expected: 404 Not Found for resource from another branch
bugs.actual: 200 with full details of foreign branch sale or shift

bugs.title: POS sales trust client-supplied cost_price
bugs.spec: readme.md §8.3; honest COGS from database batch purchase price
bugs.expected: server determines cost_price from warehouse inventory batches
bugs.actual: client-supplied cost_price is recorded directly into sales items

bugs.title: Retail admin pricing endpoints lack permission check

bugs.expected: 404 when returning import log from another branch

bugs.expected: import log marked Returned with single quotes
bugs.actual: UPDATE import_logs SET status = "Returned" crashes PG (500 identifier does not exist)

bugs.expected: 400 Bad Request when warehouse belongs to another branch
bugs.actual: 201 Created and stocks items into foreign warehouse
